title: turn_ack
description: Hub to phone, with the `corpus` capability: the answer to each `turn_offer` and each `turn_audio`.

status.description: Known in v1.0: `send` (send the Recording from `offset`), `stored` (the hub holds the Turn, its Recording checked against the offer's sha256; the phone need never offer it again), `rejected` (not stored; `reason` says why). A phone treats a status it does not know as `rejected`, and may offer the Turn again on a later connection.

offset.description: With `send`: the byte the next `turn_audio` starts at. 0 after an offer, then the length received so far.

reason.description: With `rejected`, machine-readable. Known in v1.0: `sha256_mismatch` (the received bytes do not match the offer), `size_mismatch` (more or fewer bytes than offered), `conflict` (the hub holds a different Turn under this name), `bad_turn` (a name or turn.json the hub cannot store), `too_large`, `out_of_order` (a piece at an offset the hub did not ask for, or for a Turn not on offer), `bad_message`, `storage_failed`. A phone treats a reason it does not know as a plain rejection.

message.description: With `rejected`: one short sentence for the log.
